prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate change to a 3D-IC physical design flow.
Hypothesis of the change: The parent's density-weight relaxations all act on the *global* density weight, but the real TNS cost comes from a few congested bins forcing detours. Instead of further loosening the global weight, I will make the early-iteration damping smoother (quadratic ramp over a longer window) so the density weight grows gradually and the placer spends more iterations in a low-congestion, wirelength-friendly regime before density pressure ramps up — this should reduce congestion-driven detours (overflow) and let the timing repair see shorter nets, lowering TNS broadly without starving density (the ramp still reaches full strength by iteration 100).
Rule-based digest:
total=+0.574 robust(mean-std)=+0.135 min_case=+0.112 all_valid=True
  ariane133-ng45: score=+0.112 dWNS=+9.1% dTNS=+12.9% overflow~93
  bp-ng45: score=+0.226 dWNS=+23.4% dTNS=+21.8% overflow~104
  bp_fe-ng45: score=+0.236 dWNS=+12.0% dTNS=+31.4% overflow~84
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID (failures listed), first say what kind of failure it is (legality / crash / timeout) and whether it looks systematic (all seeds of a case) or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which case/metric moved and plausible mechanism, (3) one concrete next-step suggestion. No preamble.

response: The hypothesis held: all three cases improved, with robust score +0.135 and no invalid runs. Gains are broad—dTNS +12.9% to +31.4%, dWNS +9.1% to +23.4%—consistent with the mechanism: a smoother quadratic ramp keeps the placer in a wirelength-friendly, low-overflow regime longer, so timing repair sees shorter nets. Overflow (~84–104) stayed controlled, so density wasn't starved. Next step: sweep the ramp window length (e.g., 80/100/120 iterations) and curvature to find whether a longer or gentler ramp yields further TNS gains without overflow regressing.
